events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for 'three days of peace and music'. What's your favourite memory or track from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The music world remembers influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Twenty-nine years ago, we lost a true hip-hop icon, Tupac Shakur. His impact on music and culture is still felt today. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, the world lost a guitar genius, Jimi Hendrix. His innovative playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your favourite song from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! From The Pretenders' hits to her solo work, she's a true rock legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rocking. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Song
angles.copy: Forty-one years ago, John Lennon released the timeless anthem 'Imagine' in the UK. A song that still resonates deeply today.

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: First iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, the world's favourite spy is still captivating audiences. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His legacy continues to inspire peace and imagination.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true master of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's legendary frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?
